generations.name: pawn
generations.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original transparent full-body character source art for CHECKMATE, premium realistic dark fantasy 2.5D chess action game. Frozen Palace faction. Expensive sculptural game-illustration finish, physically believable layered materials, not flat cartoon, not icon, not toy chess figurine. Camera: consistent mild elevated three-quarter view, about 30-35 degree elevation and slight 15 degree yaw; show frontal and right-side planes. Lighting: soft upper-left key, crisp pale edges and deep desaturated slate-blue side shadows. Frost-white metal and translucent blue ice with DARK blue-grey joints for readable small silhouettes on pale ice tiles. Restrained blue core only, no broad luminous aura. Entire single character and all equipment inside image, centered with at least 7 percent truly empty alpha margin on ALL four edges, including weapon tips and feet. Transparent PNG with actual alpha, no background, no fake checkerboard, no floor or baked ground shadow, no pedestal, no typography, no watermark, no extra characters, no detached ice particles. High resolution source long edge at least1024. Design broad readable material planes for later 60-80 pixel character. Preserve natural proportions, avoid fine noisy ornament.
Subject: ICE PAWN, weak small frost infantry sentinel. Small ROUND enclosed ice-and-frost-metal helmet, narrow shoulders and narrow compact chest plate, slender articulated limbs, TWO clearly visible boots. Short crystal spear held close to body and small plain ice buckler; spear tip stays near shoulder height, no tall flag/staff. Opaque frost-metal breastplate, semi-translucent ice elbow/knee joints, tiny subdued blue chest core, layered simple tunic plates. Low, thin, vulnerable soldier silhouette; overall silhouette width about70 percent of height with equipment, not bulky. No huge crown, no tall spikes, no large cape. Ready neutral stance, feet grounded and separated. Original anatomy/armour for an ice infantry character, not a blue wooden soldier.
